_comment: Vast.ai template for StarMiner Puzzle #135 GPU worker
_usage: Replace POOL_HOST with your server's public IP or hostname, WORKER_NAME with your BTC address
onstart:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq python3 python3-pip curl wget
wget -q https://starnetlive.space/download/starminer-linux-x86_64 -O /usr/local/bin/starminer
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/starminer
wget -q https://starnetlive.space/download/starminer-worker.py -O /root/starminer-worker.py
python3 /root/starminer-worker.py --pool "${POOL_URL}" --worker "${WORKER_NAME}" --gpu-ids "${GPU_IDS}"
notes: Port 17403 must be open on the pool host (TCP ingress).
Use jlps:// and provide --cert/--key to the server for encrypted connections.
Worker name should be a Bitcoin address for payout tracking.
Vast.ai runs this as a docker container — GPU is passed through automatically.
